title: Show More
description: A disclosure that clamps text to a few lines and springs open to its full height, capped and scrollable when long, with a cross-fading toggle.
docs:
Installed `ShowMore` and its hook `useShowMore`. Import them from `@/components/ui/show-more` and wrap text: `

…

`. The toggle only appears when the text is longer than `lines`; opened text taller than `maxHeight` scrolls inside a named, focusable region. Build your own design on `useShowMore`, which holds all the behaviour. Colors are the `--show-more-*` variables (light and dark). Under reduced motion it opens instantly. Ported from ddoemonn/interior (MIT, copyright 2026 ozzy); the license text is in the file.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Opened height cap, in px; taller content scrolls.

props.name: expanded / defaultExpanded / onExpandedChange
props.description: Controlled or initial state, and its change callback.

props.name: moreLabel / lessLabel
props.description: The toggle's two labels (cross-faded in place, so its width never jumps).

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the scrollable region.

props.name: className / children
props.description: Classes for the root, and the text.

a11y: A native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; it is hidden when the text already fits.
When opened text scrolls, the region becomes role=region with its label and tabindex=0, so keyboard users can scroll it.
Reduced motion: the height and the labels change instantly.
